shots.description: 橘猫在雨夜街道上稳步小跑，侧面跟拍
shots.prompt_zh: 景别：全景偏中景。构图：一只橘色虎斑猫（参考图：猫定妆图），额头 M 形条纹，琥珀色眼睛，白色胡须，环纹尾巴，全身完整入画并位于画面中央，头、尾巴和四只脚都在画面内，四周留出空间。动作：毛发被雨打湿的猫沿着湿漉漉的人行道从左往右稳步小跑，步幅适中，四条腿交替迈步，脚掌稳稳踩进浅浅的积水，前进速度和步频一致。镜头：在猫的侧面与它同速平稳横移跟拍，猫始终在画面中央。对焦：猫的脸部和身体清晰对焦。环境：雨夜住宅街道，路面积水倒映路灯和窗户暖光，细雨落下。3D 动画电影质感，冷蓝夜色与暖黄窗光对比，单一画面，镜头连贯。
shots.prompt_en: Shot size: wide-to-medium. Framing: an orange tabby cat (use cat reference image), M-shaped forehead stripes, amber eyes, white whiskers, ringed tail, whole body fully in frame and centered, head, tail and all four paws inside the frame with space around it. Action: the rain-soaked cat trots steadily from left to right along a wet sidewalk with moderate strides, legs alternating, paws landing firmly in shallow puddles, forward speed matching the stride. Camera: smooth lateral tracking alongside the cat at the same speed, keeping it centered. Focus: the cat's face and body in sharp focus. Setting: rainy suburban street at night, puddles reflecting streetlights and warm window light, light drizzle. 3D animated feature film look, cool blue night vs warm window glow, single full-frame shot, continuous camera.

shots.description: 猫头部到肩部近景，慢慢抬头、轻抖耳朵
shots.prompt_zh: 景别：近景，取猫的头部到肩部。构图：从第一帧起，同一只橘色虎斑猫（参考图：猫定妆图），额头 M 形条纹，琥珀色眼睛，白色胡须，环纹尾巴的整个头部连同两只耳朵尖就完整入画并位于画面中央，头顶和两侧留出空间，肩部也在画面内。动作：猫保持抬头的姿势，慢慢把头再抬高一点，轻轻抖一下耳朵，然后缓缓转头望向画面右侧的暖光，眨一下眼；动作幅度适中、平稳。镜头：固定机位，只做非常轻微的缓慢推近，始终不切到头部和耳朵。对焦：猫的眼睛和脸部清晰对焦，胡须上的雨珠清楚可见；背景雨夜街道虚化成暖色光斑。3D 动画电影质感，浅景深。
shots.prompt_en: Shot size: close shot from the cat's head to its shoulders. Framing: from the very first frame the same orange tabby cat (use cat reference image), M-shaped forehead stripes, amber eyes, white whiskers, ringed tail has its whole head, including both ear tips, fully inside the frame and centered, with space above and on both sides, shoulders visible. Action: the cat keeps its head up, slowly lifts it a little higher, gives a gentle ear flick, then slowly turns its head toward the warm light on the right and blinks; moderate, smooth motion. Camera: static with a very slight slow push-in, never cropping the head or ears. Focus: eyes and face in sharp focus, raindrops on whiskers clearly visible; rainy street background blurred into warm bokeh. 3D animated film look, shallow depth of field.

shots.description: 女孩走到雨窗前向外看，中近景
shots.prompt_zh: 景别：中近景，取女孩腰部以上。构图：同一个小女孩（参考图：女孩定妆图），黑色长发低马尾，淡紫色短袖针织开衫，白色小圆领，奶白色连衣裙，白色中筒袜，淡紫色搭扣圆头鞋，服装鞋袜与定妆图完全一致；她的头部完整入画、位于画面中央，头顶留出空间，不贴画面边缘。动作：女孩走近窗边停下，一只手轻轻扶在挂满雨痕的玻璃上，向外张望，表情从好奇慢慢变成担心；动作幅度适中、自然。镜头：机位在窗外，透过玻璃拍，固定后轻微缓慢推近。对焦：女孩的脸部清晰对焦，玻璃上的雨痕略虚。温暖的室内光。3D 动画电影质感。
shots.prompt_en: Shot size: medium close-up, the girl from the waist up. Framing: the same little girl (use girl reference image), long black hair in a low ponytail, short-sleeved lavender knit cardigan, small white round collar, cream-white dress, white mid-calf socks, lavender strap round-toe shoes, outfit and footwear exactly as in the reference sheet; her whole head fully in frame and centered, with headroom, not touching the edges. Action: she walks up to the window and stops, rests one hand gently on the rain-streaked glass and looks out, her expression slowly changing from curious to worried; moderate, natural motion. Camera: positioned outside, shooting through the glass, static then a slow slight push-in. Focus: the girl's face in sharp focus, rain streaks on the glass slightly soft. Warm interior light. 3D animated film look.

shots.description: 女孩开门招呼，猫走进屋，全景
shots.prompt_zh: 景别：全景。构图：同一个小女孩（参考图：女孩定妆图），黑色长发低马尾，淡紫色短袖针织开衫，白色小圆领，奶白色连衣裙，白色中筒袜，淡紫色搭扣圆头鞋，服装鞋袜与定妆图完全一致，从头顶到鞋子全身完整在画面内；同一只橘色虎斑猫（参考图：猫定妆图），额头 M 形条纹，琥珀色眼睛，白色胡须，环纹尾巴全身也完整在画面内；两者位于画面中部，四周留出空间，不贴画面边缘。动作：前门打开，暖黄的光洒到门廊上，女孩站在门内微微弯腰，轻轻招手；门口的猫抬头看她，停顿一下，然后以适中的步速稳稳走进门，脚掌踩实地面。镜头：固定机位，随后轻微缓慢推近，始终保持两者完整入画。对焦：女孩和猫的脸部清晰对焦。3D 动画电影质感，室内暖光与门外冷蓝雨夜对比。
shots.prompt_en: Shot size: full shot. Framing: the same little girl (use girl reference image), long black hair in a low ponytail, short-sleeved lavender knit cardigan, small white round collar, cream-white dress, white mid-calf socks, lavender strap round-toe shoes, outfit and footwear exactly as in the reference sheet, whole body from the top of her head to her shoes inside the frame; the same orange tabby cat (use cat reference image), M-shaped forehead stripes, amber eyes, white whiskers, ringed tail also fully in frame; both near the center with space around them, not touching the edges. Action: the front door opens and warm yellow light spills onto the porch; the girl stands inside, bends slightly and waves gently; the cat at the doorway looks up at her, pauses, then walks in at a moderate, steady pace, paws planted firmly. Camera: static, then a slow slight push-in, keeping both fully in frame. Focus: the girl's and the cat's faces in sharp focus. 3D animated film look, warm interior light against the cool blue rainy night outside.

shots.description: 猫睡在白毯上，女孩走进来给它盖小毯子，全景
shots.prompt_zh: 景别：全景。构图：温馨客厅，同一只橘色虎斑猫（参考图：猫定妆图），额头 M 形条纹，琥珀色眼睛，白色胡须，环纹尾巴蜷缩睡在地上的白色绒毛毯上，猫的全身和毛毯边缘完整在画面内；同一个小女孩（参考图：女孩定妆图），黑色长发低马尾，淡紫色短袖针织开衫，白色小圆领，奶白色连衣裙，白色中筒袜，淡紫色搭扣圆头鞋，服装鞋袜与定妆图完全一致，进入画面后从头顶到鞋子全身完整在画面内，头顶上方留出空间，绝不切到头部；画面主体位于中部。动作：猫闭眼熟睡，腹部随呼吸轻轻起伏；女孩从画面右侧以适中的步速走进来，在猫旁边跪坐下来，双手把一条淡紫色小毯子轻轻盖在猫身上，然后温柔地看着猫；动作平稳自然。镜头：固定机位，略高于猫的视线，轻微缓慢推近，始终保持女孩和猫完整入画。对焦：猫和女孩的脸部清晰对焦。落地灯暖光。3D 动画电影质感，治愈氛围。
shots.prompt_en: Shot size: full shot. Framing: cozy living room, the same orange tabby cat (use cat reference image), M-shaped forehead stripes, amber eyes, white whiskers, ringed tail curled up asleep on a fluffy white blanket on the floor, the cat's whole body and the blanket edges fully in frame; the same little girl (use girl reference image), long black hair in a low ponytail, short-sleeved lavender knit cardigan, small white round collar, cream-white dress, white mid-calf socks, lavender strap round-toe shoes, outfit and footwear exactly as in the reference sheet, once she enters is fully in frame from the top of her head to her shoes, with headroom above, her head never cropped; subjects near the center. Action: the cat sleeps with eyes closed, belly gently rising and falling; the girl walks in from the right at a moderate pace, kneels beside the cat and gently lays a small lavender blanket over it with both hands, then looks at it tenderly; smooth, natural motion. Camera: static, slightly above the cat's eye level, slow slight push-in, keeping the girl and the cat fully in frame. Focus: the cat's and the girl's faces in sharp focus. Warm floor-lamp light. 3D animated film look, heartwarming mood.

shots.description: 火星沙丘远景里的一台小机器人
shots.prompt_zh: 火星表面超大远景，橙红色沙丘绵延到地平线，薄雾和尘埃，远处一台很小的白色圆柱形清洁机器人孤零零地停在沙丘间，机身有橙色警示条纹。航拍视角缓慢向前推进。电影级写实，暖橙色调，广角，单一画面。
shots.prompt_en: Extreme wide shot of the Martian surface, orange-red dunes stretching to the horizon, thin haze and dust, a tiny white cylindrical cleaning robot with orange hazard stripes alone among the dunes far away. Aerial camera slowly pushing forward. Cinematic photorealism, warm orange palette, wide angle, single full-frame shot.

shots.prompt_zh: 一台老旧的火星基地清洁机器人（参考图：机器人定妆图），白色圆柱形机身正面印着黑色「CL-01」，底部履带，一只机械臂末端是圆形刷子，头部是单个圆形蓝色摄像头，橙色警示条纹，表面有红色沙尘，停在火星沙地上，轻轻转动头部。低机位正面中景，镜头缓慢推近。电影级写实，侧逆光，漂浮的尘埃。
shots.prompt_en: An old Mars-base cleaning robot (use robot reference image), white cylindrical body with black "CL-01" on the front, tracked base, one arm ending in a round brush, a single round blue camera eye, orange hazard stripes, red dust on the surface, parked on Martian sand, gently turning its head. Low-angle frontal medium shot, slow push-in. Cinematic photorealism, side backlight, floating dust.

shots.prompt_zh: 同一台 CL-01 清洁机器人的圆形蓝色摄像头大特写，镜头光圈缓慢收缩对焦，像在眨眼，背后夕阳逆光勾出轮廓。固定机位，浅景深。电影级写实。
shots.prompt_en: Extreme close-up of the same CL-01 cleaning robot's single round blue camera eye, the aperture slowly contracting to focus like blinking, sunset backlight rimming its silhouette. Static camera, shallow depth of field. Cinematic photorealism.

shots.prompt_zh: 微距特写，红色火星沙地上一株嫩绿的小芽从生锈的金属碎片下钻出来，细沙被风吹动，柔和侧光。固定机位，极浅景深。电影级写实。
shots.prompt_en: Macro close-up, a tiny green sprout pushing out from under a rusty metal fragment on red Martian soil, fine sand blown by wind, soft side light. Static camera, very shallow depth of field. Cinematic photorealism.

shots.prompt_zh: 火星日落后，同一台 CL-01 清洁机器人停在沙丘顶上，缓缓抬起圆形蓝色摄像头望向天空，暗蓝色天幕中一颗明亮的蓝色小星点（地球）慢慢亮起，机器人的镜头里倒映出这个蓝点。中景剪影，镜头缓慢环绕。电影级写实，冷蓝与暖橙渐变的天空。
shots.prompt_en: After sunset on Mars, the same CL-01 cleaning robot on a dune crest slowly raises its round blue camera toward the sky; in the deep blue sky a bright small blue dot (Earth) slowly appears, reflected in the robot's lens. Medium silhouette shot, slow orbit. Cinematic photorealism, sky gradient from warm orange to cool blue.

Wide shot, static camera. Realistic cinematic, cold teal grade, quiet mood, single full frame.

shots.description: 灰衣女人拿着黑伞进店
shots.prompt_zh: 从店内朝门口拍，雨夜，自动玻璃门缓缓打开，一个穿灰色长外套、黑色长发、面色苍白的女人（参考图：神秘顾客定妆图）手里握着一把收起的黑色长柄伞，慢慢走进来，地面湿漉漉反着光。全景，固定机位。写实电影感，冷色调。
shots.prompt_en: Shot from inside toward the entrance, rainy night, the automatic glass doors slide open, a pale woman with long black hair in a long grey coat (use customer reference image), holding a closed black long-handled umbrella, walks in slowly, the wet floor reflecting light. Wide shot, static camera. Realistic cinematic, cold tones.

shots.description: 店员看见第三把相同的黑伞
shots.prompt_zh: 同一个女店员站在收银台后，看着柜台上第三把一模一样的黑色雨伞，又抬头看向对面的灰衣女人，表情从礼貌变成不安。过肩近景，镜头缓慢推近女店员的脸。写实电影感，浅景深。
shots.prompt_en: The same clerk behind the counter looks at a third identical black umbrella on the counter, then up at the woman in grey, her expression shifting from polite to uneasy. Over-the-shoulder close shot, slow push-in on the clerk's face. Realistic cinematic, shallow depth of field.

shots.prompt_zh: 同一个灰衣黑发女人的面部特写，她慢慢抬起头，嘴角露出一个僵硬的微笑，眼神直视镜头，背后日光灯轻微闪烁。特写，极慢推近。写实电影感，冷色调，悬疑氛围。
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the same pale woman in grey with long black hair, she slowly lifts her head, a stiff smile forms, staring straight into the lens, fluorescent light flickering slightly behind her. Close-up, very slow push-in. Realistic cinematic, cold grade, suspense mood.

shots.description: 卷帘门外堆满相同的黑伞
shots.prompt_zh: 便利店门外夜景，卷帘门已经拉下，门口的伞架里插满了几十把一模一样的黑色雨伞，旧招牌字迹斑驳，雨水从屋檐滴落。中景，镜头缓慢上摇到招牌。写实电影感，暗调。
shots.prompt_en: Exterior of the convenience store at night, the rolling shutter is down, the umbrella stand by the door is stuffed with dozens of identical black umbrellas, the old sign is weathered, rain dripping from the eaves. Medium shot, slow tilt up to the sign. Realistic cinematic, low-key lighting.

Wide shot, slow push forward. Japanese anime film style, warm orange vs deep green, soft volumetric light, single full frame.

Medium-wide shot, camera tracking alongside. Japanese anime film style, rim backlight.

shots.prompt_zh: 同一只红狐狸的近景，它张嘴开口说话（口型自然），一只前爪轻轻按在茶壶盖上，茶壶冒出带金色光点的热气。中近景，固定机位后轻微推近。日式动画电影风格。

shots.prompt_zh: 同一只红狐狸的眼睛特写，金色瞳孔慢慢亮起；镜头随即缓慢拉远成远景，整座茶亭的灯笼一盏盏亮起，金色光带环绕茶亭，夜幕降临竹林。一次连续拉远，不跳切。日式动画电影风格，暖金与深蓝对比。
shots.prompt_en: Extreme close-up of the same red fox's eyes, golden irises slowly glowing; the camera then pulls back in one continuous move to a wide shot as the pavilion's lanterns light up one by one, golden ribbons of light circling the pavilion, night falling over the bamboo forest. Japanese anime film style, warm gold vs deep blue.

shots.description: 鹅钻进外卖箱叼走餐盒
shots.prompt_zh: 同一个骑手停在红绿灯前，银色头盔，深蓝色反光条外套，黑色电动车和黑色外卖箱不变。一只鹅从路边钻进他的外卖箱，叼走了一份外卖盒，骑手瞪大眼睛回头。中景，固定机位。写实电影感，喜剧节奏，动作清晰。
shots.prompt_en: The same rider stops at a red light; a goose pops out from the roadside into his delivery box and snatches a food box, the rider turns back wide-eyed. Medium shot, static camera. Realistic cinematic, comedic timing, clear action.

shots.prompt_zh: 同一个骑手骑着同一辆黑色电动车在小巷里追一只叼着外卖盒的鹅，路边行人纷纷让路。全景，镜头侧面平行跟拍。写实电影感，轻快喜剧氛围。
shots.prompt_en: The same rider chases a goose carrying a food box through a narrow alley on his e-scooter, neighbors stepping aside. Wide shot, side tracking camera. Realistic cinematic, light comedic mood.

shots.prompt_zh: 同一个骑手头盔下的面部特写，银色头盔和深蓝色反光条外套仍在，满头大汗，喘着气，露出憨厚又无奈的笑。特写，固定机位。写实电影感，街灯暖光。
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the same rider's face under the helmet, sweating and panting, giving an honest, helpless grin. Close-up, static camera. Realistic cinematic, warm streetlight.

shots.prompt_en: At an office building entrance, the same rider hands the order over with both hands; the customer opens the box and the goose is sitting inside, the two stare at each other. Over-the-shoulder medium shot, static camera. Realistic cinematic, comedic ending.
